notes: Provenance: rate_limit_groups_per_second values and the ORDER_INFO peak-hours note are transcribed from openapi.tossinvest.com/openapi-docs/overview.md (retrieved 2026-08-17); the vendored spec defines only the group names and the X-RateLimit-* headers. No code depends on these numbers.
Rate limits are documented per client x API group and may change without notice; the X-RateLimit-Limit response header is authoritative over this table.
ORDER_INFO drops to 3 requests/second during 09:00-09:10 KST; ORDER stays at 10.
Exactly one access token is valid per client; re-issuing invalidates the previous token immediately.
Calls from IPs not registered in WTS Settings > Open API > Allowed IP management fail with 403.
There is no sandbox environment; every order-path call with real credentials is live.
